200.description: The service is ready to receive traffic

503.description: The service is draining (shutdown in progress), or Postgres or Kafka is not reachable, and must not receive new traffic. While draining the body is `{"status":"not_ready"}` (`application/json`); when a dependency check fails it is an RFC 7807 problem of type `dependency-unavailable` whose detail names the failing dependencies (`application/problem+json`).

schema.description: RFC 7807 Problem Details for HTTP APIs.
schema.title: ProblemDetails
